import java.lang.reflect.GenericArrayType;
import java.lang.reflect.ParameterizedType;
import java.lang.reflect.Type;
import java.lang.reflect.TypeVariable;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

import com.alibaba.fastjson.JSONArray;
import com.alibaba.fastjson.parser.DefaultJSONParser;
import com.alibaba.fastjson.parser.JSONLexer;
import com.alibaba.fastjson.parser.JSONToken;
import com.alibaba.fastjson.parser.deserializer.ObjectDeserializer;
import com.alibaba.fastjson.util.TypeUtils;

/**
 * A custom codec for serializing/deserializing object arrays.
 *
 * <p>
 * The original implementation was vulnerable to Fastjson deserialization
 * attacks because it accepted any component type without validation.
 * This patch introduces a strict whitelist of safe component types and
 * rejects any array whose element type is not on the list.  The whitelist
 * contains primitive wrappers, {@link String}, {@link Number} subclasses,
 * {@link java.util.Date}, {@link java.util.UUID}, and all classes in the
 * {@code java.time} package.  Primitive types and enum types are also
 * permitted.  Any attempt to deserialize an array of an unsupported type
 * results in an {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
 * </p>
 */
public class ObjectArrayCodec implements ObjectSerializer, ObjectDeserializer {

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    /* Whitelist of safe component types                                     */
    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    /** Set of classes considered safe for array deserialization. */
    private static final Set<Class<?>> SAFE_COMPONENT_TYPES =
            Collections.unmodifiableSet(new HashSet<Class<?>>(Arrays.asList(
                    // Primitive wrappers
                    Integer.class, Long.class, Short.class, Byte.class,
                    Float.class, Double.class, Boolean.class, Character.class,
                    // Common numeric types
                    java.math.BigDecimal.class, java.math.BigInteger.class,
                    // String and UUID
                    String.class, java.util.UUID.class,
                    // Date/time types
                    java.util.Date.class,
                    java.time.LocalDate.class, java.time.LocalDateTime.class,
                    java.time.Instant.class, java.time.ZonedDateTime.class,
                    java.time.OffsetDateTime.class, java.time.LocalTime.class,
                    java.time.YearMonth.class, java.time.Year.class,
                    java.time.MonthDay.class, java.time.Period.class,
                    java.time.Duration.class
            )));

    /**
     * Checks whether a component type is allowed for deserialization.
     *
     * @param cls the component class to check
     * @return {@code true} if the class is in the whitelist or is a primitive
     *         or enum type; {@code false} otherwise
     */
    private static boolean isAllowedComponentType(Class<?> cls) {
        if (cls == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (cls.isPrimitive() || cls.isEnum()) {
            return true;
        }
        if (SAFE_COMPONENT_TYPES.contains(cls)) {
            return true;
        }
        // Allow any subclass of java.time.* (Java 8 time API)
        Package pkg = cls.getPackage();
        return pkg != null && pkg.getName().startsWith("java.time");
    }

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
    /* Deserialization logic                                                  */
    /* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    @SuppressWarnings({ "unchecked", "rawtypes" })
    public <T> T deserialze(DefaultJSONParser parser, Type type, Object fieldName) {

        final JSONLexer lexer = parser.lexer;

        // Handle JSON null
        if (lexer.token() == JSONToken.NULL) {
            lexer.nextToken(JSONToken.COMMA);
            return null;
        }

        // Handle JSON string literal -> byte[]
        if (lexer.token() == JSONToken.LITERAL_STRING) {
            byte[] bytes = lexer.bytesValue();
            lexer.nextToken(JSONToken.COMMA);
            return (T) bytes;
        }

        Class<?> componentClass;
        Type componentType;

        // Resolve component type for generic array types
        if (type instanceof GenericArrayType) {
            GenericArrayType gArray = (GenericArrayType) type;
            componentType = gArray.getGenericComponentType();

            if (componentType instanceof TypeVariable) {
                TypeVariable<?> typeVar = (TypeVariable<?>) componentType;
                Type objType = parser.getContext().type;

                if (objType instanceof ParameterizedType) {
                    ParameterizedType paramType = (ParameterizedType) objType;
                    Type rawType = paramType.getRawType();
                    Type actualType = null;

                    if (rawType instanceof Class) {
                        TypeVariable<?>[] typeParams = ((Class<?>) rawType).getTypeParameters();
                        for (int i = 0; i < typeParams.length; ++i) {
                            if (typeParams[i].getName().equals(typeVar.getName())) {
                                actualType = paramType.getActualTypeArguments()[i];
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (actualType instanceof Class) {
                        componentClass = (Class<?>) actualType;
                    } else {
                        componentClass = Object.class;
                    }
                } else {
                    componentClass = TypeUtils.getClass(typeVar.getBounds()[0]);
                }
            } else {
                componentClass = TypeUtils.getClass(componentType);
            }
        } else {
            // Non-generic array type
            Class<?> clazz = (Class<?>) type;
            componentType = componentClass = clazz.getComponentType();
        }

        // Validate component type against whitelist
        if (!isAllowedComponentType(componentClass)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Deserialization of array with component type "
                    + componentClass.getName()
                    + " is not allowed for security reasons.");
        }

        JSONArray array = new JSONArray();
        parser.parseArray(componentClass, array, fieldName);
        return (T) toObjectArray(parser, componentClass, array);
    }

    // ... other methods ...
}
